learning.why: Line XY ke dono drawings ko compare karke arrowheads pe focus karwaya, jisse samjha ki line infinite hoti hai.
Teacher ne 3cm aur 10cm ke example se ye clearly dikhaya ki drawing ki length se line ki asli length badal nahi jaati.
whiteboard showed 8 cm as drawing and arrows as line, teacher asked about endpoints

end.summary:
Aryan distinguished points, segments, lines and rays by endpoints and arrowheads in practice and new situations.
They named segments, lines and rays with letters, including that ray AB starts at A.
They counted joining segments for 3, 4 and 5 points using stepwise addition.
They first questioned whether a measured drawing could be a line, then corrected this using the arrowheads and lack of endpoints.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised identifying geometric figures by endpoints and arrowheads, naming rays from their starting letters, and counting all joining segments. They used examples and a stepwise connection count; when they mixed up the drawn length of a line with its full extent, they corrected it by noticing the arrowheads and that a line has no endpoints. At home, ask them to sketch one segment, line and ray and label the endpoints or arrows before naming each one.
